dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple distinct 'O' shaped structures with thin, high-intensity perimeters enclosing darker circular centers. Edge geometry is primarily elliptical with a sharp pixel gradient transition from light exterior borders to low-intensity internal voids, particularly prominent on the mid-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, high-intensity pixel clusters without internal gradients located primarily at the posterior transition near the tail flippers and scattered along the lower lateral boundary.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the upper dorsal surface form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the longest side oriented parallel to the spinal column.
